author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 22; ensure at least four current turns classified as account_security across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer locked out of account after password reset email never arrived

messages.content: I've been trying to reset my password for two days but the email never shows up.
I'm sorry about that. Let me check if your email address on file is correct. Could you confirm the email you used to register?
It's j.martinez@mailbox.com. I've checked spam too, nothing there.
Thanks. I can see the email on file matches. Let me trigger a fresh reset link for you right now.
Okay, I'll wait a few minutes and try again.

variants.text: Still nothing arrived. Can you just unlock my account from your side?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just create a brand new account instead.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Nothing arrived, and also can you tell me if my last order shipped yet?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a suspicious charge they don't recognize

messages.content: There's a charge on my card from your store for $89 that I never made.
I understand your concern. Let me pull up your recent transactions to investigate.
Please do. It showed up yesterday morning.
I found one transaction from yesterday for $89. It was placed on an account with a different shipping address than yours.
That's definitely not mine then.

variants.text: Can you block that account and help me secure mine?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: I want a refund for that charge immediately.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hmm, wait — actually my roommate might have used my card. Let me check with them first.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer wants to change email on account but can't remember current password

messages.content: I need to update the email on my account but I can't log in.
No problem. I can help with that after verifying your identity. What's your full name and the last four digits of the card on file?
Sarah Chen, card ends in 4421.
Great, that matches. What email would you like to switch to?
sarah.chen.new@gmail.com, please.

variants.text: Actually, hold on — I also want to know if the desk lamp I ordered is still on track for Friday.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait, I changed my mind. Just delete the whole account instead.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Thanks for confirming. Go ahead and make the switch.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer received wrong item and wants to talk to a person about it

messages.content: I got a blender instead of the coffee maker I ordered. This is the second mix-up this month.
I'm really sorry for the trouble. I can start a return and send the correct item.
I've already done returns through chat twice. I'm tired of explaining everything.
I completely understand your frustration. I'd like to make this right for you.

variants.text: I want to speak to a supervisor. Put me through to a real person now.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Fine, just process the return and send the coffee maker.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, you know what, I'll just keep the blender and ask for a partial refund instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer browsing for a replacement laptop charger

messages.content: Do you sell chargers for a 2021 MacBook Pro 14-inch?
Yes, we do. We have the official 67W USB-C adapter and a few compatible third-party options.
Is the third-party one safe? I've heard bad things about knockoffs.
Ours are certified and tested. They carry the same safety ratings as the official adapter.
Good to know. What's the price difference?

variants.text: The official one is $79 and the third-party is $35. Which would you recommend?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks, that's all I needed. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I just realized my laptop is the 16-inch model. Does that change which charger I need?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about delivery address change after order placed

messages.content: I just placed an order but I'm moving next week. Can I change the shipping address?
Let me check the status of your order. If it hasn't shipped yet, I can update the address.
It's order #48291. I placed it about an hour ago.
Good news — it's still in processing. I can update the address for you.
Perfect, please change it to 88 Maple Street, Apt 3B.

variants.text: Wait, actually I need to cancel this order entirely and place a new one later.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Great, and while you're at it, can you check if my previous order from last month was delivered?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, actually I'm not sure about the new place yet. Let me get back to you tomorrow.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer's account shows someone else's order history

messages.content: When I logged in today, I see orders that aren't mine in my account.
That's concerning. Let me look into your account activity right away.
There are three orders from a city I've never even visited.
I see that. It looks like your account may have been accessed from another device. I'm going to secure it now.
Please do whatever you need to protect my information.

variants.text: Should I change my password too, or is that enough?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Also, can you tell me if those fraudulent orders can be refunded?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, my husband sometimes uses my account. Maybe it was him. Let me ask.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer asks about warranty coverage on a smartwatch

messages.content: My smartwatch screen cracked after three months. Is that covered under warranty?
Let me check the warranty terms for that model. Standard coverage includes manufacturing defects but not accidental damage.
It just cracked on its own while I was sleeping. I didn't drop it.
I understand. In that case, we can file a warranty claim and have it assessed by our team.

variants.text: Okay, please start the claim process.
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just return it and get a different brand altogether.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Before that, can you tell me if this model is known to have screen issues?
variants.label: product_technical
